subject: Planning for Class of 2020 Senior Events
overview: School administrators and student leadership held a forum to discuss alternatives for senior events, including prom and graduation, following the COVID-19 school closures. The body reviewed proposals for car parades, virtual awards, and postponed in-person ceremonies to be finalized after a community survey.

items.title: Introduction and Event Vision
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Peter Cushing and Headmaster Paul D'Alleva opened the forum, stating that senior events will be postponed rather than canceled.

items.title: Student Perspective
items.summary: Class President Mark Jean-Mary shared student concerns regarding closure and the importance of maintaining social connections while following safety protocols.

items.title: Prom and Graduation Contingencies
items.summary: Administrators discussed moving graduation to Hormel Stadium and hosting a multi-day series of events to replace the traditional prom and ceremony.

items.title: Distribution of Regalia and Yearbooks
items.summary: The high school has received caps and gowns and plans to distribute them via a social-distanced line so students can decorate them and participate in future events.

items.title: Vocational and Academic Recognition
items.summary: Staff proposed a virtual 'Oscar-style' honors night and specific recognition for vocational programs to be produced remotely by media technology students.

items.title: Senior Parade and Community Visibility
items.summary: The body discussed organizing a car parade involving local police and creating banners or digital photo cycles for the local cable station to celebrate graduates.

items.title: Postponement Timing and Preferences
items.summary: Community feedback during the forum indicated a preference for live events over virtual ones, with Thanksgiving weekend favored for a postponed celebration if summer gatherings are restricted.

items.title: Locker Access and Senior Photo Project
items.summary: Administrators are awaiting safety guidelines for locker cleanouts and invited families to submit senior photos and memories to a central district email for social media features.

items.title: Financial Planning and Survey Development
items.summary: Administrators addressed budget constraints for events and committed to distributing a formal survey to students and parents to gather data on preferred dates and logistics.
